title: Full review follow-ups: cleanup items not yet confirmed fixed
description:
The 2026-10-17 full review (/reviews/2026-10-17-full-review/ in project files) top six findings are fixed on develop: user routes bound to the signed-in user, customer cross-account role bounded, computer record uses conditional writes, worker registration secured, turn stream reconnects and token storage fixed with a report-only CSP, and the acceptance smoke test now runs after development and staging deploys.

Not confirmed either way (check each against develop before working): README is a ~700-line changelog; stray features/computer_owner_credential_renewal.feature-e containing a conflict marker; develop package.json version lags main releases; Kanbus board commits are about half of develop history; report-only CSP has not been promoted to enforcing; infra findings exist only in the Claude Doc 'Chatticus full review' (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/37d2f3b8-a89b-47ba-8013-989badfc68ff). Lower-priority findings in the three findings files are untriaged.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Classification against origin/develop (2026-10-19):
1. Stray features/computer_owner_credential_renewal.feature-e with conflict marker: was TRUE; FIXED by PR 612 (deleted; real feature still listed in cucumber-features.txt; CI green).
2. develop package.json version lag (0.44.0 vs main 0.50.0): was TRUE; main-only commits were release commits and merge commits only; FIXED by merge-commit sync PR 613 (develop now 0.50.0). It will lag again after each release; recurring cost of semantic-release on main only.
3. README is a ~700-line changelog (769 lines): STILL TRUE, not changed. Proposal: keep README.md as stable (what it is, quickstart, layout, gates, links); move the "What is live today" status log to docs/STATUS.md; keep the AGENTS.md milestone rule but point it at docs/STATUS.md. Owner decides.
4. Kanbus board commits about half of develop history: STILL TRUE (133 of last 300 commits start with "pm:"). By design per AGENTS.md; mitigation if desired is squashing board updates or batching, owner decision.
5. Report-only CSP not promoted to enforcing: STILL TRUE (infra/lib/web-content-security-policy.ts and web-stack test assert only Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only, and assert the enforcing header is absent). Promotion needs report review first; not a cheap fix, left open.
6. Infra findings only in the Claude Doc: NOT CHECKABLE from this Mac (document not in repo); needs triage from the doc itself. Lower-priority findings files likewise untriaged.
Ticket left open for items 3, 4, 5, 6.
